messages:
paul: kicking off helm upgrade for checkout-service -> chart checkout-chart@3.2.1, app image tag checkout:1.13.0. running canary rollout.

deploy-bot: queued canary rollout for checkout-release v1.13.0 (canary 10% for 15m). details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/checkout-release/1768804100 :rocket:

alex_t: can we pin the chart dependency in the Chart.lock and also set imagePullPolicy if this is a hotfix?

maria: agree on pin. Recommend slow-start canary and a short pre-prod smoke. snippet for values:

```
canary:
  weight: 10
  duration: 15m
  slow_start: true
```

sre_oncall: watching prod metrics (p95/latency, 5xx rate, pod restarts). please run `kubectl rollout status deployment/checkout-frontend -n prod` after pods start.

deploy-bot: canary pods created: checkout-frontend-canary-5f7d9 (2/2 ready). route update applied (10%).

sre_oncall: noticing slight p95 uptick (120ms -> 210ms) but still within SLO. no errors yet.

paul: thanks, keeping an eye. will hold global traffic until 15m completes.

--- 12 minutes later ---

sre_oncall: seeing 5xx spike from canary instances (0.2% -> 3.8%) and p95 jumped to 380ms. correlated with the new image.

maria: can we throttle down to 0% or rollback quickly? also, open the smoke test logs.

paul: rolling back canary now. running:

```
helm rollback checkout-release 1 --namespace prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/checkout-frontend -n prod
```

deploy-bot: rollback executed. release reverted to stable revision 0. All stable pods back to 100% traffic. :white_check_mark:

sre_oncall: verified 5xxs back to baseline, p95 returned to ~130ms. good call to rollback.

maria: created follow-up issue: "pin chart + add pre-rollout smoke for checkout-service" and a PR to pin chart version in chart dependencies: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/438

alex_t: note: next canary do 5% ramp for first 5m, then 15% for 10m. also add image digest pinning in CI to avoid accidental tag drift.

paul: agreed. updating release notes and will schedule another attempt once PR merges. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
